transcript.speaker: p-gwen
transcript.text: Okay, I think that's everyone. Can people hear me? Jade, you're on mute, I think. Oh, no, you're fine.

transcript.speaker: p-jade
transcript.text: yeah i can hear you

transcript.speaker: p-gwen
transcript.text: Good. Let's do a round of updates, receiving first since Jade has to get back to the dock.

transcript.speaker: p-jade
transcript.text: two pallets came in friday after you all left and one this morning. all the fastener lots are binned and tagged. the packing slip on one box didnt match what was in it so i set it aside

transcript.speaker: p-talia
transcript.text: Ooh which vendor was that? I can check the PO lines 😬

transcript.speaker: p-jade
transcript.text: i'll send you a photo after this

transcript.speaker: p-talia
transcript.text: Thank you 🙏

transcript.speaker: p-samir
transcript.text: uh, on my side the anodize house is still saying thurs for the, uh, the batch we sent out, but i wouldnt bet on it. nxt wk more likely. i'll call them again tmrw

transcript.speaker: p-nora
transcript.text: So the question is whether the anodize slip affects the build start. Let me answer that: it does not affect the first six units, but it will hit anything that needs the black finish. One, we can start with the bare ones. Two, we hold the black ones. Three, I need a firm date before I commit the floor.

transcript.speaker: p-samir
transcript.text: yep, understood. firm date by eow if i can get it

transcript.speaker: p-kofi
transcript.text: Um, from the NPI side, I think the fixture for the shoulder housing is, probably fine? I ran the first article on the CMM yesterday and the bore was close to nominal. Not 100% sure the second one is the same though, the probe was acting weird

transcript.speaker: p-nora
transcript.text: Can you rerun the second one before we sign the report? I'd rather not find out at assembly.

transcript.speaker: p-kofi
transcript.text: Yeah, yes, I'll rerun it this afternoon

transcript.speaker: p-claire
transcript.text: While we're on lead times, the quarter's open commitments are about where we forecast. I'll circulate the sheet later today, mostly so everyone can check their lines.

transcript.speaker: p-talia
transcript.text: Is that the one with the new tabs? I got lost in it last time 😅

transcript.speaker: p-claire
transcript.text: It is. I collapsed the tabs, so it should be easier.

transcript.speaker: p-samir
transcript.text: also the, uh, the heat treat shop wants us to batch the rods with another job, which could be good or bad

transcript.speaker: p-nora
transcript.text: Bad if it adds a week. Ask them what the batching does to the turnaround and tell me, don't just accept it.

transcript.speaker: p-jade
transcript.text: sorry the forklift battery died back in a sec

transcript.speaker: p-gwen
transcript.text: No problem. Talia, anything on your side before I get to the slips?

transcript.speaker: p-talia
transcript.text: Just that two of the reorder points need bumping. I'll put it in the doc 🙏

transcript.speaker: p-kofi
transcript.text: Wait, can I ask something? Is the cable harness vendor the same one as last build? I think the connectors changed

transcript.speaker: p-samir
transcript.text: same vendor. connectors changed on our end tho, they have the new drawing

transcript.speaker: p-gwen
transcript.text: Okay, the one I need to flag. Bearing set for torso and pelvis structure (height gauge) has slipped again, it's now 11/6, not the second like I told you last week. The supplier had a bad lot at inspection and re-ran it.

transcript.speaker: p-nora
transcript.text: Understood. So the torso inspection fixture work can't finish until then, correct? I'll move that on the schedule.

transcript.speaker: p-gwen
transcript.text: That's right, yes.

transcript.speaker: p-jade
transcript.text: back. whats the status on the bearing thing

transcript.speaker: p-samir
transcript.text: later jade, ill fill you in after

transcript.speaker: p-claire
transcript.text: One more thing from me. Please get receipts for the shop supplies into the folder this week, finance is chasing a few.

transcript.speaker: p-jade
transcript.text: ok

transcript.speaker: p-gwen
transcript.text: Alright. Let's wrap there. Thanks all.
